description.en: Open the Explorer at Ichthyosauria to inspect the linked, locator-bearing source claim together with this package's current occurrence context. This is a reproducible evidence entry point, not a phylogenetic result or a complete history of the group.
description.zh: 在探索器中打开鱼龙类，结合本包当前的出现记录背景检查带有精确来源定位的关联声明。这是可复现的证据检查入口，不是系统发育结果，也不是该类群的完整历史。

limitations: The linked claim retains its own specimen, stratum, model, confidence and source-locator boundaries. The Explorer route does not establish an exact origin, global first or last appearance, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or package-specific phylogeny.

description.en: Open a source-bounded Ichthyosauria time window in the map to inspect sampled occurrence context linked to this package.
description.zh: 在地图中打开有来源边界的鱼龙类时间窗口，检查与本包关联的采样出现背景。

limitations: The interval follows the linked package range and claim; map markers are sampled records and do not establish a complete distribution, exact origination or extinction, or direct ancestry.

title.en: Marine reptiles and pterosaurs evidence comparison
title.zh: 海生爬行动物与翼龙证据比较

description.en: Compare Ichthyosaurus and Plesiosauria through package-linked claims and bounded occurrence context; this side-by-side route is an evidence inspection aid.
description.zh: 通过本包关联的声明与限定出现背景比较鱼龙与蛇颈龙类；并列页面仅用于证据检查。

limitations: The two sides retain separate source, sampling, range and uncertainty boundaries; visual differences are not tests of evolutionary causation or a package-specific phylogeny.

title.zh: 短吻鱼龙形类正模出现窗口

description.en: Open the map at a rounded age of 248 Ma for Cartorhynchus holotype AGM I-1. The specimen is from the Upper Nanlinghu Formation at Chaohu, Anhui, China; this source-bounded locality and stratum are a sampling boundary, not a global range or ancestor claim. No model-derived age is used.
description.zh: 在地图中打开约四舍五入为 248 Ma 的 Cartorhynchus 正模 AGM I-1。该标本来自中国安徽巢湖上部南陵湖组；此来源限定的地点与地层只是取样边界，不是全球延限或祖先主张。年龄不来自模型推算。

limitations: The rounded navigation age follows the available holotype range; specimen AGM I-1, Chaohu locality and Upper Nanlinghu stratum remain the sampling boundary. Map markers are sampled records and do not establish a global FAD, LAD, complete distribution or direct ancestry.

title.zh: 巢湖龙母体标本出现窗口

description.en: Open the map at a rounded age of 248 Ma for maternal specimen AGM I-1 of Chaohusaurus. The specimen is from Majiashan Quarry, Chaohu, Anhui, in the Procolumbites Zone of the Nanlinghu Formation; locality and stratum define the sampling boundary, with no model-based age or ancestor inference.
description.zh: 在地图中打开约四舍五入为 248 Ma 的 Chaohusaurus 母体标本 AGM I-1。标本来自安徽巢湖马家山采石场南陵湖组 Procolumbites 带；地点与地层定义取样边界，不使用模型年龄，也不推断祖先关系。

limitations: The rounded age is the available specimen-level navigation value, not a radiometric date. AGM I-1, Majiashan Quarry, the Procolumbites Zone and Nanlinghu Formation are the sampling boundary; markers do not establish a global genus range, global FAD/LAD or ancestral status.

title.zh: Stenopterygius 软组织标本出现窗口

description.en: Open the map at the rounded age of 178.4 Ma (the range midpoint) for Stenopterygius specimen MH 432. Its locality is Holzmaden, Germany, in the Toarcian Posidonia Shale; that study sample and stratum are the sampling boundary, and the age is a stage-scale translation rather than a model output or global endpoint.
description.zh: 在地图中打开 Stenopterygius 标本 MH 432 的四舍五入中点年龄 178.4 Ma。地点为德国霍尔茨马登，地层为托阿尔期 Posidonia 页岩；该研究样本与层位是取样边界，年龄是阶级尺度换算，不是模型输出或全球端点。

limitations: The rounded age sits within the available Toarcian range for specimen MH 432. Holzmaden and the Posidonia Shale define the sampling boundary; map markers do not establish a complete Stenopterygius duration, global FAD/LAD or direct ancestry.

description.en: Open the map at the rounded age of 203.55 Ma (the range midpoint) for holotype LWL-MFN P 64047 of Rhaeticosaurus. The specimen comes from clay pit #3 near Bonenburg, Germany, in a Rhaetian Exter Formation bed; this locality and stratum are the sampling boundary, not a model-derived global origin or ancestor claim.
description.zh: 在地图中打开 Rhaeticosaurus 正模 LWL-MFN P 64047 的四舍五入中点年龄 203.55 Ma。标本来自德国博嫩堡附近 3 号黏土坑的瑞替期 Exter 组某层；地点与地层是取样边界，不是模型推导的全球起源或祖先主张。

limitations: The rounded age is within the available Rhaetian holotype range and is not a direct date on LWL-MFN P 64047. Bonenburg clay pit #3 and its Exter Formation bed are the sampling boundary; markers do not establish a global plesiosaur or genus FAD, LAD or direct ancestry.

title.zh: 薄片龙类 Aphrosaurus 样本出现窗口

description.en: Open the map at the rounded age of 69.05 Ma (the range midpoint) for the reappraised Aphrosaurus furlongi elasmosaurid specimen sample. Its locality is the Moreno Formation of California, United States, in the Maastrichtian; this formation-level study sample and stratum are the sampling boundary, with no model-based age or family-wide FAD/LAD inference.
description.zh: 在地图中打开重新评估的 Aphrosaurus furlongi 薄片龙类样本的四舍五入中点年龄 69.05 Ma。地点为美国加利福尼亚州 Moreno 组，时代为马斯特里赫特期；该组级研究样本与地层是取样边界，不使用模型年龄，也不推断科级 FAD/LAD。

limitations: The rounded age follows the available 72.1–66 Ma Aphrosaurus study-sample range. Moreno Formation, California and its Maastrichtian stratum are the sampling boundary; map markers do not establish the complete Elasmosauridae distribution, global FAD/LAD or direct ancestry.

title.zh: 双臼椎龙怀孕标本出现窗口

description.en: Open the map at the rounded age of 78 Ma for gravid Polycotylus specimen LACM 129639. The adult-and-fetus specimen is from the Pierre Shale of Kansas, United States; its locality and stratum form a sampling boundary, and the approximate age is not a model output or genus-wide endpoint.
description.zh: 在地图中打开约四舍五入为 78 Ma 的 Polycotylus 怀孕标本 LACM 129639。成年体与胎儿标本来自美国堪萨斯州 Pierre 页岩；其地点与地层构成取样边界，近似年龄不是模型输出或属级端点。

limitations: The rounded age is the paper's approximate age within the available Pierre Shale range. LACM 129639, Kansas and the Pierre Shale are the sampling boundary; markers do not establish a complete genus range, global FAD/LAD or direct ancestry.

title.zh: 无齿翼龙科修订样本出现窗口

description.en: Open the map at the rounded age of 85.15 Ma (the range midpoint) for Kellner's pteranodontid revision specimen sample. The specimens come from Niobrara and Pierre Shale units in the Western Interior of the United States; this study locality and stratum set define the sampling boundary, with no model-based age or family-wide FAD/LAD claim.
description.zh: 在地图中打开 Kellner 无齿翼龙科修订样本的四舍五入中点年龄 85.15 Ma。标本来自美国西部内陆的 Niobrara 与 Pierre 页岩单元；这些研究地点与地层定义取样边界，不使用模型年龄，也不作科级 FAD/LAD 主张。

limitations: The rounded age is the midpoint of the available 89.8–80.5 Ma Coniacian–Campanian study envelope. Niobrara and Pierre Shale units in the Western Interior are the sampling boundary; markers do not establish a complete family range, global FAD/LAD or ancestor sequence.

title.zh: Tupandactylus 软组织标本出现窗口

description.en: Open the map at the rounded age of 112.5 Ma (the range midpoint) for Tupandactylus specimen MCT.R.1884. The five-slab specimen is from the Crato Formation of the Araripe Basin, Brazil; its specimen, locality and stratum are a sampling boundary, and the Lower Cretaceous translation is not model-derived or a global pterosaur endpoint.
description.zh: 在地图中打开 Tupandactylus 标本 MCT.R.1884 的四舍五入中点年龄 112.5 Ma。该五块板保存的标本来自巴西 Araripe 盆地 Crato 组；标本、地点与地层构成取样边界，下白垩世换算不来自模型，也不是翼龙全球端点。

limitations: The rounded age is the midpoint of the available Crato Formation navigation envelope, not a direct date on MCT.R.1884. The named specimen, Araripe Basin locality and Crato stratum are the sampling boundary; markers do not establish a genus-wide range, global FAD/LAD or feather origin.

title.zh: 哈米翼龙产卵地点出现窗口

description.en: Open the map at the rounded age of 112.5 Ma (the range midpoint) for the Hamipterus egg and embryo specimen-site sample. The locality is the Shengjinkou Formation in the Turpan-Hami Basin, Xinjiang, China, with eggs repeated across at least four stratigraphic levels; this formation and sampled stratum levels are the sampling boundary, not a model-derived range or global nesting distribution.
description.zh: 在地图中打开 Hamipterus 卵与胚胎地点的四舍五入中点年龄 112.5 Ma。地点为中国新疆吐鲁番—哈密盆地盛金口组，卵化石重复出现在至少四个层位；该组与取样层位是取样边界，不是模型推导的延限或全球筑巢分布。

limitations: The rounded age is the midpoint of the available Shengjinkou Formation envelope, not a direct date on individual eggs. The Turpan-Hami locality and four sampled levels define the sampling boundary; markers do not establish a global Hamipterus range, FAD/LAD or nesting distribution.
